irregularities.finding: data/bridge/labels.tif and existing_faults.tif are pixel-identical (60,988 px each, 100% overlap) — the provided 'training labels' are the existing catalogue itself; 'new fault' truth exists only on the private test side. All local gating therefore simulates gaps with fold splits (gems/holdout.py).
irregularities.evidence: measured this session; cross-checks organizers' wording on page/967 that labels are mapped faults that 'may contain inaccurate data'

irregularities.finding: Census TIGER2024 publishes no per-county RAILS layer for our 22 counties (all tl_2024_*_rails.zip -> 404); rails/trails are folded into ROADS under MTFCC S1400/S1500. Our road-distance confound therefore includes rails+trails by construction.
irregularities.evidence: https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/TIGER2024/ (listing parsed by CI); data_external/fetch_manifest.json on branch public-layers

irregularities.finding: NBMG Qfaults ArcGIS REST server rejects pagination ('Pagination is not supported.') and outFields=OBJECTID (OID field is FID); geometry returns in NAD83 Albers(-117) regardless of inSR. Worked around with recursive bbox tiling + maxAllowableOffset=200 m; fetched trace counts (739/351/89 in-bbox) match the published census exactly.

GeoDAWN Area-2 outline covers 100% of the competition footprint outside Area-1 (no footprint pixel lies outside both official polygons): acquisition-domain contrasts within the footprint are Area1 vs Area2 only.
irregularities.evidence: rasterization of official GeoDAWN_area2_outline.zip (ScienceBase item 657e1d85d34e23d3533209f7, CC0 1.0); data/confounds/confounds_provenance.json
irregularities.impact: simplifies the window confound; the four contractor blocks remain seam-approximated (block boundaries are not in the release)

irregularities.finding: The C2S2 0.956 AUC for 'accessibility explains the catalogue' was dominated by a catalogue-geometry leak: leave-one-out removal of distance-to-Well-Constrained-trace collapses it to 0.495 (chance). Headline audit numbers therefore also report the clean variant (labels 0.570, predictions 0.611; both within torus-shift-null noise).
irregularities.impact: major interpretive finding — reported, not hidden
